## About this deck

Same content as the light flagship, but the whole deck rides
`ssus-dark: true`: night ground, haze text, sky links, the night series
palette, and the night-stacked lockup on the hero.

There is no `prefers-color-scheme` anywhere — a deck is a shared-room
artifact; the room picks once, at `ssus-dark:`, not per audience laptop.
